subject: ACME Health SOC 2 & audit evidence — post-call recap and next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Jensen <sarah.jensen@acmehealth.com>, security@acmehealth.com
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Feb 2027 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call recap: SOC 2, retention, audit logs — next steps

Hi Sarah / ACME security team — thanks again for a productive conversation today. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps so we keep procurement moving: 

Summary of pain points you raised:
- Need for SOC 2 Type II evidence and a short summary called out for vendor security reviews.
- Audit log access and exportability (who can request logs, retention window, typical retention export formats).
- Data retention and deletion controls (DPA alignment, customer-controlled deletion).
- Pen test evidence / recent vuln remediation summary for high-risk components.
- Clarification on network/data residency and encryption-in-transit and at-rest.

Goals we heard:
- Confirm that Redwood can provide SOC 2 Type II report and a high-level callout of controls relevant to data residency, logging, and encryption.
- Get a template DPA or the specific clauses ACME needs to validate.
- Determine whether audit log exports and event-level logs are available for the 12–24 month retention window you require.

What we will deliver by next Friday (Feb 19):
1) A 1-page SOC 2 summary and artifact index (SOC2 type, date, scope, and where to request full report) — attachment: redwood_SOC2_summary.pdf
2) An audit-logs overview doc that explains retention, exports, and how customers can request logs — attachment: redwood_audit-logs-overview.pdf
3) Pen test summary (redacted findings + remediation dates) — will include pen_test_summary_stubs.zip as a stub; we can provide expanded artifacts under an NDA if needed.

Proposed ACME action items:
- Share the procurement timeline and any specific DPA language you require so we can surface legal.
- Let us know if you need a live session with our security engs focused on logging/export formats.

I'll follow up with the artifacts linked above and propose a short 30-min technical call next week to walk through logs/export format. Thanks again — talk soon.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0182

Attachments: redwood_SOC2_summary.pdf (PDF), redwood_audit-logs-overview.pdf (PDF), pen_test_summary_stubs.zip (ZIP)

From: Sarah Jensen <sarah.jensen@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: security@acmehealth.com
Date: Thu, 11 Feb 2027 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: SOC 2, retention, audit logs — next steps

Marissa — thanks for the clear recap, this is helpful. A few clarifying questions from our security and procurement teams: 

- Can you confirm whether the SOC 2 report you mentioned is Type II and the date range covered? We will need the report to be within the last 12 months.
- For audit logs: does Redwood provide an exportable events log (e.g., JSON/CSV) that includes user id, request id, timestamp, and model call meta (e.g., model_id, tokens)? If so, can you outline the typical retention windows and whether retention is configurable per-customer?
- Regarding DPA: we will share a checklist of clauses we need (data exports, deletion, subprocessors, security incident notifications). Do you have a standard DPA you can share now?
- Pen test evidence: a redacted summary is fine for procurement, but our security team may request a full report under NDA. Will Redwood accommodate that?

Procurement timeline: we are trying to close vendor review by Feb 25 to align with our pilot start in March. If you can get the SOC2 summary + audit logs overview by Feb 19 as proposed, that would be great.

Thanks — cc'ing security@acmehealth.com for their input.

—Sarah
Sr. Manager, Security Engineering | ACME Health

Thanks — I’ll synthesize before sending to ACME.

- Pen test: full report available under NDA. We can start an NDA process immediately if you want the full artefact.
